label: PF Backlog 183
title: Tool-loop fallback ladder: re-prompt WITH tools before the no-tool fallback
body: _generate_with_tools: when a tool loop ends with 0 writes + a tiny final, FIRST re-prompt WITH tools (system: use http_get/write_file; produce the document), and only if that still stalls fall back to a single no-tool full-document call. So research agents actually search instead of emitting an offline doc. Verified compileall+wired_audit.
